story_review.one_viewing_summary: A driverless car picks up at a San Antonio airport curb. A plan of the city shows a 60 square mile zone opened in February. From above, an empty car is carried down Salado Creek, and another sits stranded in floodwater. A federal recall covering 3,791 cars says the software may let a car slow and then drive into standing water, shown from above and then close. The remedy is stamped under development, interim weather limits reached every car by April 20, and the airport ride is open beside that unfinished remedy.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Curb arrival to the curb with the door open beside the record's under-development remedy. The ending answers the opening question with the source limit in the picture and invents no outcome.
